name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Holds media at a fixed shape; round and frame the media inside with the card's corners and hairline.
usage: Keep screenshots, video and logo previews from shifting the layout while they load (16 / 9 for a page capture, 1 / 1 for a logo). Put the image inside with object-cover and the card's corners.
avoid: A frame without the media's real ratio

reference.source: No dashboard counterpart: it keeps media placeholders at their shape as context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx does, framed as the brand frames screenshots
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
